sloka: अप्रकम्प्यो यता स्थाणुश्चन्द्रे सौम्यत्वमीदृशम् ।नेदृशाः पार्थिवाः पूर्वं भवितारो नराधिप ।। ७.३७.७ ॥
transliteration: aprakampyo yatā sthāṇuścandre saumyatvamīdṛśam ।nedṛśāḥ pārthivāḥ pūrvaṁ bhavitāro narādhipa ।। 7.37.7 ॥

translations.english: You are unshakable like a pillar, and possess such gentleness as found in the moon; O king of men, there have been no such kings before, nor will there be in the future.
translations.hindi: अब हे महाबलवान्‌! तुम इन्द्र को छोड़ दो ओर इनके बदले तुम देवताओं से क्या चाहते हो सो भो तत्ता दो
